description: For handyman visit, this inspection checklist records task sequence, authorized repair boundaries, customer-supplied items, added-work protocol, cleanup, and cost cap. Its supporting evidence includes task-level photos, measurements, parts used, functional checks, inaccessible conditions, and customer decisions.

blocks.guidance: Link this handyman visit review to the service record.
blocks.label: Handyman Visit Review Reference

blocks.guidance: Confirm the reviewed handyman visit location and assets.
blocks.label: Handyman Visit Context

sections.guidance: Identify the handyman visit service, reviewed areas, crew, and customer.
sections.title: Account and Service Cycle

blocks.guidance: Mark each handyman visit item after direct review.
items: Every authorized visit item is checked separately
Fit, fastening, finish, and function meet the recorded criterion
Customer-supplied items and unused materials are reconciled
Adjacent surfaces, access points, and furnishings are undamaged
Deferred regulated-trade or hidden-condition work is identified
Cleanup, photos, customer walkthrough, and follow-up are complete
blocks.label: Handyman Visit Task and Area Checks

blocks.guidance: Use one handyman visit row for each reviewed area.
blocks.label: Handyman Visit Area and Task Results

blocks.guidance: Stop any item involving hidden hazard, regulated trade work, structural change, unsafe access, or exceeded authority. Route unresolved handyman visit work for review.
blocks.label: Handyman Visit Applicable Review Boundary

sections.guidance: Check completed handyman visit work by task, room, zone, or equipment.
sections.title: Recurring Service Quality Check

subtitle: Handyman Visit Inspection Checklist: multi-item handyman visit record using customer account, task sequence, and task-level photos.
title: Handyman Visit Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during multi-item handyman visit record when the handyman visit record must identify customer account, rooms, task list, fixtures, materials, access, property protection, and time allowance. Complete the applicable handoff for completed-task reconciliation, deferred referrals, materials return, property walkthrough, and customer acceptance.
